settlementMerit.rationale: Colinsburgh is a modest but genuine heritage visit: its conservation village has a current community-authored 12-stop tour and the Town Hall hosts a live public community-cinema programme. It has no dependable café-led daytime stop, public picnic site, general visitor car park or public toilet, so remains in the 60–70 band.
